title: Seed RAG Technique Component Relationship Support
description: Conservative support objects for the seed RAG technique to component relationships. This support records maintainer rationale for including declared technique-component edges in the seed dataset and does not claim external factual proof, benchmark superiority, or universal RAG architecture behavior.

references.title: RKM Seed Technique Component Modeling Rationale
references.abstract: Internal maintainer analysis describing why the first seed technique-component relationships are modeled as conservative optional component-use relationships rather than mandatory architecture rules or benchmark-supported claims.
notes: This reference records seed dataset modeling rationale and should not be treated as external factual proof.

claims.statement: RELATIONSHIP-10101 is included as a conservative seed dataset relationship because Hybrid Retrieval can use a Keyword Retriever in some implementations.
claims.rationale: The claim explains seed dataset modeling rationale and avoids asserting that every hybrid retrieval system must use this component.

claims.statement: RELATIONSHIP-10102 is included as a conservative seed dataset relationship because Hybrid Retrieval can use a Semantic Retriever in some implementations.
claims.rationale: The claim explains seed dataset modeling rationale and avoids asserting that semantic retrieval is mandatory in every implementation labeled as hybrid retrieval.

claims.statement: RELATIONSHIP-10103 is included as a conservative seed dataset relationship because Hybrid Retrieval can use Rank Fusion in some implementations.
claims.rationale: The claim explains seed dataset modeling rationale and avoids asserting that all hybrid retrieval pipelines require rank fusion.

claims.statement: RELATIONSHIP-10104 is included as a conservative seed dataset relationship because Reranking can use a Cross-Encoder Reranker in some implementations.
claims.rationale: The claim explains seed dataset modeling rationale and avoids asserting benchmark superiority or universal reranking architecture behavior.

evidence.summary: The maintainer analysis motivates modeling Keyword Retriever as a component that Hybrid Retrieval can use in some seed dataset relationships.
evidence.interpretation: This evidence supports inclusion of the relationship as seed dataset modeling rationale only and does not establish external factual proof.
limitations: Internal maintainer rationale is weak support and should not be interpreted as a universal RAG architecture rule.
